caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with chashu, nori, menma, and naruto fish cake, arranged neatly in a blue-and-white patterned bowl. Warm, ambient lighting highlights the meal on a wooden table.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, browned edges, and visible marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, with visible noodles, green onions, and a pink swirl, appearing rich and glossy.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, slightly curved pieces with a smooth, glossy surface.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern and raised rim, glossy finish.
Naruto fish cake: pink swirl on pale white, scalloped edge, slightly textured surface.
